Splunk Installation on Kali Linux:


Go to Splunk Website and Sign Up with your work/business email:

![](data:image/png;base64,)Get a wget link for .deb command:wget -O splunk-10.6.2.5-b07ce3b48d58-linux-amd64.deb "[https://download.splunk.com/products/splunk/releases/10.6.2.5/linux/splunk-10.6.2.5-b07ce3b48d58-linux-amd64.deb](https://download.splunk.com/products/splunk/releases/10.6.2.5/linux/splunk-10.6.2.5-b07ce3b48d58-linux-amd64.deb)"



![](data:image/png;base64,)After this check .deb package is installed:

![](data:image/png;base64,)Now it is installed:

![](data:image/png;base64,)Once splunk is installed give credentials using below cmds:

cd /opt/splunk/bin

sudo ./splunk start –accept-license


To start splunk use: cd /opt/splunk/bin

sudo ./splunk start –run-as-root
